text.EN: Someone died here. We should remember that.
text.TL: May namatay dito. Dapat nating alalahanin 'yon.

text.EN: Another body in the dirt. World's unforgiving.
text.TL: Isa na namang bangkay sa lupa. Malupit ang mundo.

text.EN: They fought hard, by the looks of it.
text.TL: Lumaban nang husto, base sa hitsura.

text.EN: Someone lost a life here. Tread with respect.
text.TL: May nawalan ng buhay rito. Maglakad nang may galang.

text.EN: Looks like they got trapped. Rest easy.
text.TL: Mukhang naipit sila rito. Mamahinga ka na.

text.EN: Could've been any of us. Keep walking.
text.TL: Kahit sino sa atin pwedeng maging ganyan. Lakad na.

text.EN: Another survivor cut down too early.
text.TL: Isa na namang survivor ang pumanaw nang maaga.

text.EN: Body's cold. Let's make sure we don't end up like this.
text.TL: Malamig na ang bangkay. Siguruhin nating hindi tayo matutulad dito.

text.EN: Rest in peace, stranger. Let's keep moving.
text.TL: Sumalangit nawa ang kaluluwa mo. Magpatuloy tayo.
